We know she does not achieve balance, so the only way for (feels_fulfilled XOR achieves_balance) to be true would be if she feels fulfilled. Since the implication’s consequent is false (she doesn’t find happiness), the antecedent must be false, hence she does NOT feel fulfilled.
8. ∀x (finds_creative_expression(x) → feels_fulfilled(x)). The contrapositive is: ¬feels_fulfilled(x) → ¬finds_creative_expression(x). Therefore Shelby does not find creative expression.
9. ∀x (pursues_passion(x) → finds_creative_expression(x)). Its contrapositive: ¬finds_creative_expression(x) → ¬pursues_passion(x). Hence Shelby does not pursue her passion.
Therefore the statement "Shelby pursues her passion" is false in every model of the context.
